title: DayScore offline-first data path
subtitle: Static PWA: hash router, localStorage, optional Firestore sync, CSV export

nodes.label: Today view
nodes.detail: done / partial / not done + SVG progress ring

nodes.label: 5 AM day boundary
nodes.detail: unmarked past days close to not_done

nodes.label: CSV export
nodes.detail: one row per task, day score per day

notes: Firebase sync is optional. The config file is gitignored, so a fresh clone runs in local-only mode and never makes a network call.
The day boundary is 5 AM: before it, the app still edits yesterday's tasks.
Day score is (done x 1.0 + partial x 0.5) divided by the marked tasks, rounded to a percent.
The repo ships no Firestore security rules file, so a configured Firebase project must secure its own documents.
Static site with no build step and no runtime dependencies; `npm test` runs a standalone Node script.
